items.lede: A pair of unsecured databases exposed sensitive information about hundreds of millions of people—including data that could let attackers “own” a victim’s digital life.
items.title: Database Leaks Expose 3.5 Billion Usernames, Passwords, and Documents

items.lede: The scale of the exposed data underscores how important it is to take steps to stay safe online.
items.title: Researchers find 3.6 billion usernames, passwords and documents in unsecured databases
